example_sentences_in_bangla: অনেক ঢোঁড়েও তার কোনো পাত্তা পাইনি।
বাজারে ঢোঁড়া করে একটা ভালো ফল পেলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: I searched everywhere but couldn't find any trace of him.
After rummaging through the market, I found a good fruit.
note: The idiom implies thorough but often futile searching, rooted in everyday rural or semi-urban activities.
